title: My workout isn't showing up in augo
seoTitle: Workout Not Showing in augo: How to Fix | augo support
description: A missing workout is nearly always a sync gap between the watch, the provider and augo. Here is what to check, in order.
summary: A missing session is almost always still sitting on the watch or with the provider. Check that it has finished uploading to Garmin Connect, Strava or whichever source is connected — augo can only see what the provider has already received.
questionForms: my run didnt appear in augo
my garmin ride didnt show up
my athletes training feed is empty
why cant i see my session
nothing has come through since yesterday
why is my training feed blank

body.html: Almost every missing workout is a sync gap rather than a lost session. augo can only display what the connected provider has already received, so the fix is usually upstream.

1. Check the session uploaded from the watch

Open Garmin Connect, Strava, Polar Flow, Coros or whichever app your watch syncs to and confirm the session is actually there. If it isn’t, the watch hasn’t finished uploading — nothing downstream can help until it does.

2. Check a source is connected

If no workouts have ever appeared, the athlete probably hasn’t connected a data source yet. The athlete has to do this from their own account — a coach can’t connect it for them. See which devices and apps augo syncs with.

3. Give it a few minutes

Sync is automatic but not instantaneous. A session has to travel from watch to provider to augo, and each hop takes time.

4. Watch for duplicate sources

If a watch already pushes to Strava and you connect both the watch and Strava, the same session can arrive twice. Connecting one source is enough.

Still missing?

If the session is in the provider, a source is connected, and it still hasn’t appeared after a while, get in touch — include the athlete, the date and the provider, and we can trace it.

faqs.question: Why is my new athlete’s feed empty?
faqs.answer: Most often they have joined augo but not yet connected a device or app. Connecting a data source is done by the athlete from their own account.

faqs.question: Why did the same workout appear twice?
faqs.answer: Usually because two sources are connected that both carry the same session — for example a Garmin watch that also pushes to Strava, with both connected. Connecting one source is enough.

faqs.question: How quickly should a workout appear?
faqs.answer: Sync is automatic, but a session has to reach the provider before augo can see it. If the session is visible in Garmin Connect or Strava and still missing from augo well afterwards, contact support.
